name: Implement nf-visual: vi-inspired modal for nameforma mutations
summary: Vi-inspired spatial navigation engine for browsing and mutating Forma entities. Core interfaces in src/navigable-view.ts: INavigable (three-axis navigation), IView (lens/detail), IRenderable, ZenoCoord (2D→1D bijection for RenderDetail). Default implementation: WorldView in src/world-view.ts (needs alignment with new design). Navigation: j/k moves cursor, zo/zc zooms detail, / and ? search. Mutations via executeAction.

rawActions.name: Design WorldView observation pattern
rawActions.summary: How does WorldView observe/sync with World changes? Event-driven vs interval-based vs hybrid. What's the Forma sequence (all Formas vs filtered)? Does cursor persist across syncs? Design the observation lifecycle before implementing cursor state.
